subject: alt-f
title: C.CONT.------ALT.F.
description: Diagram in PCC-29. C-CONT (composite continuance) is crossed with ALT-F (alternative functionalism) — what does composite continuance require of alternative functionalism, and vice versa? The arrow points to ALT-F, so ALT-F is the subject: ALT-F → C-CONT (the crossing). ALT-F → GRAD (gradualism) directly. GRAD → STF (source transfer). From the STF line branch a second ALT-F label and SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars). SOC-RT-P has a *dashed* line to POL-P (political policies); in Braxton's legend a dotted line amplifies some aspect of the main concept it is connected to. From that dashed line branch AFL (affinity alignment) and CULT-INFO-F (culture information focus) → (R)PART (the reality of participation).
